g.text: SIDE QUEST
Memorina
2D metroidvania · Godot 4 · in progress
A game about a world that’s forgetting its seasons.
You play Ivo, who learns an old song on a flute and
plays the color back into the world, one region at a
time. Zelda is all over it, on purpose.
UNDER THE HOOD
The grey isn’t a filter, it’s stopped time. One memory
formula runs in GDScript for the gameplay and in a shader
for the picture.
Dialogue, cutscenes and songs are data. Choices become
facts in the save, and the world is derived from them.
A playtest harness drives the real game from input
timelines and screenshots it, so I can see a change, not just
test it.
